verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented end-to-end voice latency numbers and no latency tuning guidance. The closest items are a speech-to-speech model option that skips the separate transcribe and synthesize steps, and generic 'performance metrics' in call history. Both are adjacent features, not documented latency figures or tuning docs backing speed claims.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented end-to-end voice latency numbers or tuning guidance backing the platform's speed claims
